home.metaTitle: PeakUI - Accessible React components, styled with plain CSS.
home.metaDescription: Accessible React components built on React Aria Components and Tailwind CSS v4, styled with BEM classes and CSS custom properties.
home.title: React components that take on your brand.
home.description: PeakUI is an open-source library of {count} accessible React components. Give it one color and it builds the whole theme, light and dark, with readable contrast.

brands.title: See it in another brand's colors
brands.hint: Pick one and the whole page follows.
brands.openBuilder: Tune this theme in the builder

accessible.title: Accessible without extra work
accessible.body: Keyboard support, focus handling and screen-reader labels are built in, on top of React Aria. Every component targets WCAG 2.2 AA.
accessible.try: Try it: Tab into the list, then use the arrow keys.

theme.title: A whole theme from one color
theme.body: Give the engine an accent. It derives every color for light and dark, and keeps text contrast at 4.5:1 or better.
theme.caption: Text on each of these colors is chosen and checked by the engine.

css.title: CSS you can read and override
css.body: Styles ship as plain CSS files. Each part of a component has a class name and its own CSS variables, so a restyle is a few lines.

agents.title: Docs your AI assistant can read
agents.body: Every page is also published as Markdown, next to an index for assistants and a JSON list of components.

notFound.description: Sorry, the page you're looking for could not be found.

footer.tagline: Built on React Aria Components and Tailwind CSS.
